name: COLOR☆COLLAR
source:
You are a college student who is busy with your assignments, and you are trying to capture the boys you meet in your daily life. How you spend your time after school and on holidays is up to you!

[From [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11990]novelgame.jp[/url]]
translation:
你是一名忙碌于作业的大学生，你正试图捕捉你在日常生活中遇到的男孩。放学后和假期如何度过取决于你！

[来自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11990]novelgame.jp[/url]]
